venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 9/28 (MOD MKZ; H82/L58).** Net sales $681 vs target $858 (-20.6%). Food $134. Comps $35.40 (employee 50% $18, Industry Love $14.40, O4W $3). 26 guests, check avg $26.21. Quiet start to Monday, no pop until 9pm; sold 7 Meal Deals all day. At 9 a service industry group came in and stayed to close — a rep brought a shochu with a snake in the bottle; they ordered lots of cocktails and food, and the vending machine saw some love. FOH and BOH both completed cleaning duties. Kitchen: smooth ticket times, Sysco order placed for tomorrow; get a head start on wing prep. Needs: glassware restock. Low: Tanqueray, wings. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by MKZ.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 9/28 (MOD & Chef MD/DJ; nice, sunny).** Net sales $709 vs target $1,500 (-52.7%). Food $219. Comps $8 (1.12%). 30 guests, check avg $24. A slower Monday with a lot of cool people; a 10-top of friendly, polite twenty-somethings came in. Meal Deal Monday was a success — most guests got a meal deal and expressed interest in returning. Kitchen: smooth sailing, happy folks. Maintenance: many of the candles turn off mid-shift (not a charging issue; they turn back on with the remote) — keep an eye on it. Favorite moment: regulars Gabe and Maya stopped in after a long absence. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 9/28 (AM MOD Maggie S; PM MOD Maggie H; crisp autumn air).** Total net sales $5,493.03 vs target $7,380 (-25.6%). Food $1,335. Comps $171.15. 131 guests (Tock), check avg $41.93. No events reported. DC/AM: $983.01; D&C (PM): $4,510.02; Garden/6A: NA. AM: Monday funday, ran solo and crushed all waves; plenty of espresso tinis; fresh cold brew; restock kombucha at open; tea shipment confirmed; low on oat milk and coconut milk. PM: very slow, everyone out early except kitchen. Kitchen: chill night with Dante, no dishwasher (get well soon Marv); prep in good shape for tomorrow; low on tart shells, sliced scallop, basil vinaigrette, fingerling, aioli, 8oz burger meat, agnolotti; 911 lime crumble and cola onion. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 9/28 (MOD/Chef Kyler, Will, Raekwon).** Total EOD net sales $5,892 vs target $3,889 (+51.5%). Food $643, beverage $5,250. Comps $37. 167 guests (SevenRooms), check avg $35. Filled gradually from 6:40, basically packed until 10:40 with a mix of parties leaning older; lots of monster checks. Casa Lotos sotol happy-hour event (15-top with a sales rep) filled the heart of the room; 167 covers, 5 solos, 4 large parties, 0 investor cocktails. Top sellers: Casa Lotos Sotol Event, Burner Phone, Ice Cold Wodka Shots. Door: exciting end to the Nor'easter and kickoff to busy season; full room by 6:30; Maia had first training night; industry guests from the Wayland and Ferdi. No-show: Kevin Myers 9pm for 2 (not charged). Breakage: 2 waters. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 9/28 (MOD & Chef Mikey & Josh; warm).** Net sales $4,190 vs target $3,712 (+12.9%). Food $858 (beat food target too). Marquee $4,190; Standing Room $0. Comps $63.30 (employee 50%, investor discount, F&F/industry). 106 guests, avg order $85.50. Solid Oyster Monday — started with 22 covers, many walk-ins. Around 9:45 the glycol machine in the cage began spewing water, flooding the cage/stairwell/hallway; unplugged it and shut breaker 42; ~45 min of mopping while the room filled; waitlist never above 3 parties. Maintenance: URGENT — glycol machine needs a technician (electrical board); GG is on it in the AM. 86: Bread & Butter, House Pickles. No incidents; no-shows charged. Entered by Mikey.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 9/28 (MOD Josh).** Total net sales incl. events $12,122 (all event sales — buyout event) vs target $2,279. Comps not reported; event void $1,198.71. 45 guests, check avg $269.38 (net/guests). Report was posted late (9/29 ~10am ET) because the Typeform Slack integration was reinstalled. Went well: buyout event. Food service smooth but charcuterie/crudités came out late (7:30pm, event ended 8pm); recommendation to schedule both cooks for such events. Maintenance: curtains; mid water tap leak (tightened). Favorite moment: deep cleaning after service.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 9/28 (AM Sam & Shannon; PM Justin & Marcus; sunny, warm).** Net sales $3,187 vs target $3,550 (-10.2%). Food $1,169. Comps $174. 100 guests (OpenTable 34 AM + 66 PM), check avg $31.87. Municipal AM $547, PM $2,641; Sun Club $68; Hot Eye $0. Quiet morning (15 guests before 1pm) lifted by a large food tour; restaurant empty through happy hour, 3–6 tables at a time through dinner; super chill night. Sun Club extremely slow — nothing until 4:15pm, 3 margaritas sold. Kitchen: slow, low only on mushrooms. Maintenance: BOH roof leaking again near the prep stairwell. Alex Day joined for dinner at the bar. No incidents. Entered by Justin.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Monday 9/28 (MOD Curtis Hayes; sunny, high 60s).** Net sales $7,464 vs target $8,000 (-6.7%). Food $1,592. Comps $281 (3.7%), voids $82; shifties make up most comps. 146 guests (65 reservations), avg guest spend $52.56. Slow start, solid 7:30–9 dinner pop; bar on cruise control. S'fian solo in kitchen — will need kitchen support until new hire is trained. Sales $534 below prior Monday. Prep tartare tomorrow. Maintenance: Orcas to replace bar freezer driver; Ecolab drain/fly treatment ~9a; Otter Plumbing to fix well 300 tin rinser flow. 86/low: Uwajima Gimlet, Tartare. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
